classes.name: HIV pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP)
classes.description: Emtricitabine/tenofovir disoproxil (Truvada and generics), emtricitabine/tenofovir alafenamide (Descovy), cabotegravir LA (Apretude), lenacapavir (Yeztugo).
classes.plainDescription: A daily pill or long-acting shot that prevents HIV.

classes.name: Single-tablet HIV treatment regimens
classes.description: Complete single-tablet regimens: bictegravir/FTC/TAF (Biktarvy), dolutegravir/abacavir/lamivudine (Triumeq), dolutegravir/lamivudine (Dovato), dolutegravir/rilpivirine (Juluca), darunavir/cobicistat/FTC/TAF (Symtuza), elvitegravir/cobi/FTC/TAF (Genvoya), rilpivirine/FTC/TAF (Odefsey), efavirenz/FTC/TDF and generics; cabotegravir/rilpivirine LA (Cabenuva).
classes.plainDescription: A once-a-day pill that treats HIV.

records.verificationNote: Read on PDF p.21: emtricitabine-tenofovir DF 200-300 mg generic Tier 0, QL 30 tabs every 30 days; the list states $0 copay when medically necessary for PrEP and a copay for treatment. The $0 condition is a cost-share rule, not a PA or step, so restriction is null. Descovy 200/25 mg is Tier 0 with the same PrEP cost-share rule (PDF p.20). Apretude (cabotegravir LA) and Yeztugo (lenacapavir) are listed on the pharmacy section (PDF pp.18, 20); absence of other PrEP products is not read as exclusion.

records.verificationNote: Read on PDF p.20: BIKTARVY TAB Tier 2 (preferred brand), QL 30 tabs every 30 days, no PA or step. Chosen as the guideline-preferred single-tablet regimen with no barrier. Judgment call: the generic efavirenz-emtricitabine-tenofovir DF 600-200-300 mg tablet is Tier 1 with no PA (PDF p.20) and is the lowest-cost single-tablet option; it is listed as an alternative because efavirenz is not the usual first-choice regimen. The strength is not printed on this list. Juluca (dolutegravir-rilpivirine) is not listed; absence is not read as exclusion. Cabenuva is an injection and may sit under a medical benefit. [Strength 2026-11-04: list names no strength ("Single tablet (strength not printed on the formulary)"); set to the label starting dose (scripts/data/label-strengths.json)]
